content: OCI CSPM baseline follows the CIS OCI Foundations Benchmark: IAM (MFA on all users, avoid using root/tenancy admin creds day-to-day, API keys rotated, scoped IAM policies not tenancy-wide admin, no delete permission for storage service-level admins), Object Storage (buckets not public, encryption at rest via Vault-managed keys), Networking (security lists/NSGs not open to 0.0.0.0/0 for admin ports, VCN flow logs enabled), Logging (Cloud Guard enabled, Audit log retention, object storage/bucket logging enabled), Compute (boot volumes encrypted). Prowler implements OCI checks (e.g. identity_storage_service_level_admins_scoped) against these same CIS controls. OCI's native Cloud Guard is the built-in CSPM equivalent.
